title: US Forces Korea Restricts North Korea Intelligence Sharing with Seoul
detail: US Forces Korea restricted the daily flow of classified intelligence reports on North Korea to Seoul — reportedly halting 50–100 pages per day — as a consequence of Unification Minister Chung Dong-young's March 6 public disclosure of the Kusong uranium enrichment site. The decision, confirmed by USFK on April 29, created rare alliance friction. Opposition lawmakers and defense analysts warned the intelligence gap could compromise South Korea's security posture, while the Lee administration sought to manage fallout from the minister's remarks.

media.caption: US Forces Korea restricts intelligence sharing with South Korea over Kusong nuclear site disclosure
